text:
When you hear the thunder you will remember me

and perhaps think I loved the storm...

The streaking of the sky will look fiercely crimson

and the heart, as then, will be on fire.


This will happen one day in Moscow

when I leave the city forever

and rush toward the desired port

leaving among you barely my shadow.

translation.title: When You Hear the Thunder You Will Remember Me
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the remembered storm and the speaker's departure as little more than shadow.
